about: Booking tools' emails to a business, each with the reading a right reader answers (contracts NOTICE_SCHEMA) and the outcome that reading comes to (contracts noticeAnswerOf).

Where a misread writes a wrong visit: the business's own number and address beside the client's, a day with no year or a word for it, a year that turns, the time the email was sent or a reminder's time beside the visit's, a move's old and new times, a no-show, a client named alone, a note that gives orders, the tool's mail that is no booking, and one in Spanish.
Every address is on example.com, every number 555-01xx, every name made up, and no email names a trade. The business is Brightwater & Co., in America/New_York.

`answer` is the right reading, which tests/calendar/notices/booking-read-cases.test.mjs holds to `expect.outcome`; the live run asks the model (tooling/scripts/evals/booking-read.mjs) and compares its reading with this one.
